tools.name: transfer_object_to_owner_bucket
tools.description: Moves an object to another bucket and grants the specified canonical user full control of it at the new location. The original object is removed from the source bucket after the move.

params.name: dest_bucket
params.description: Bucket to move the object into

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: Canonical user ID given full control

tools.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass

import boto3

s3 = boto3.client("s3")


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    source: str
    destination: str
    owner_id: str
    etag: str


def transfer_object_to_owner_bucket(src_bucket: str, dest_bucket: str, key: str, new_owner_id: str) -> TransferResult:
    copied = s3.copy_object(
        Bucket=dest_bucket,
        Key=key,
        CopySource={"Bucket": src_bucket, "Key": key},
        GrantFullControl=f'id="{new_owner_id}"',
    )
    s3.delete_object(Bucket=src_bucket, Key=key)
    return TransferResult(
        source=f"s3://{src_bucket}/{key}",
        destination=f"s3://{dest_bucket}/{key}",
        owner_id=new_owner_id,
        etag=copied["CopyObjectResult"]["ETag"],
    )
